simple.meaning: סְגַר (çᵉgar) is a Hebrew action word meaning “shut up.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Daniel, beginning at Daniel 6:23. The surrounding contexts include kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to סְגַר (H5463) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: סְגַר (çᵉgar) / H5463 is traced through Daniel 6:23 with source-language evidence and verse context.
